title: Engine contribution
description: What one shared result is made of, written by `engine.py share` to <recording>/engine/share/<name>.json. The engine only lists the files; the app uploads them with the user's consent (and its wording's version) and may delete the list after. File paths are relative to the recording folder.

name.description: pitch, kits, or a label set's name (ball-1, moments-1).

recording.description: From the manifest, so the server can tie it to the game.

version.description: The engine's build (a commit), so results can be compared across versions.

summary.description: The result in numbers: pitch (approved first time, rounds, fitted size), kits (purity, structure per round), ball and moments (items labelled, by status).
